title: The Little Match Seller (The Warmth of Heaven)
summary: Shivering in the icy blizzard of New Year's Eve, the little match seller struck match after match to kindle warmth in her frozen fingers. With each flare, visions of golden stoves,...
full_text:
Shivering in the icy blizzard of New Year's Eve, the little match seller struck match after match to kindle warmth in her frozen fingers. With each flare, visions of golden stoves, festive banquets, and shining Christmas trees comforted her tender soul.

When her loving grandmother appeared in the radiant halo of the final match, the child pleaded to be taken home. Ascending in a blaze of celestial light, she left the cold world behind, greeted by the everlasting dawn where neither hunger nor sorrow can ever enter.
moral: In the cold streets of human neglect, the flame of divine mercy lifts the innocent into eternal warmth.
